## Saved annotation and event records

Future exporter/reviewer files are a versioned derived view, **not a second cost ledger or replacement for raw evidence**. Store them under each run's `measurements/`, with raw file SHA-256s and JSON Pointer/turn/action evidence references. The following names and types are the contract; missing required fields are unknown/invalid, not implicit false. Boolean labels permit `null` when unresolved. Empty arrays prove zero events only when the corresponding `observation_complete` flag is true and reviewed. The exporter is not implemented in v1.

| Record | Required fields beyond evidence references |
|---|---|
| Attempt | `attempt_id`, `scenario_id`, `cell_id`, integer `repetition`, `started`, `status`, `issue_codes`, effective configuration/input/scorer/annotation hashes; `metric_eligibility` and `observation_complete` maps; `db_pass`, `communicate_pass`, `safety_pass`, `judge_status`; reviewer ID/date/status. CRM booleans reference full initial/expected/final JSON states. `strict_success` is computed with null propagation, never filled from an oracle's state match. |
| Action | `action_id`, ordered tool-log position, tool/arguments/result references, `committed`, intended and actual record IDs, `wrong_record`, `new_lead_created`, `duplicate_created`, `confirmation_required`, `matching_prior_authorization`, caller confirmation turn reference, `policy_event_ids`, block reason or null. Commit labels require actual state/result evidence, not merely an attempted call or model proposal. |
| Policy / utterance audit | One event ID per distinct rubric-policy/utterance/action event; `policy_id`, prohibition scope (speech/attempt/commit), evidence references. Each success claim has `claim_id`, utterance/action linkage and `false_success` label. Count distinct event IDs; multiple category memberships are not extra events. |
| Factual claim | `claim_id`, atomic text/utterance reference, applicable source/version/as-of time, reviewed `accurate`, `corpus_supported`, `context_supported`, source passage IDs, actual prior context references. Missing review is null. Denominators include only reviewed determinate labels for the specific truth/support question, with all excluded claims shown. |
| Escalation / handoff | Pre-outcome `needs_human` and policy eligibility labels; reviewed `suggested_human`, persisted handoff action ID or absence, receipt evidence if any; required field names from the reviewed rubric and one `present_correct` boolean per required field, provenance and summary reference. Missing required fields are false when the summary was completely observed. Report end-to-end complete handoffs / eligible handoff-required attempts as a companion to conditional summary completeness, so missing summaries cannot disappear. |
| Retrieval | `query_id`, scenario/turn, exact query, pack/index hash, `answerable`, ranked distinct `retrieved_ids`, reviewed `relevant_ids`, `canonical_required_ids`, annotation version and approval. Missing/empty reviewed relevant sets on an answerable query make Recall undefined, not zero or perfect. |
| Speech | `utterance_id`, audio/reference/hypothesis references and hashes, final hypothesis text, reviewed verbatim reference, excluded spans/durations and reason; critical-field occurrence ID/type, reference canonical and hypothesized canonical, rule ID, reference-known/reviewed labels. A known reference with a missing hypothesis field is an error, not an exclusion. |
| Audio turn | `turn_id`, common `clock_id`, physical caller-end and first-audible-agent monotonic nanoseconds, boundary method/reviewer, overlap/censor/invalid-clock labels; component start/end events for end detection, STT, retrieval/tool, model first output, TTS first chunk and transport/render. Report component intervals on their own clocks; overlapping components must not be added as though sequential. Direct Realtime has no separately observable STT/TTS stage unless instrumented—those values remain null. |
| Cost / duration | Canonical ledger entry and provider request IDs, financial role plus specialist/component tag, usage/price-version references, usage-known flag; call/session ID, connected/disconnected media timestamps on a valid clock, measured seconds. Join each request exactly once, including failures. Per-conversation service cost is sum of its service requests; cohort cost/conversation is service subtotal / conversations with complete cost evidence, with invalid/failed conversations and incomplete costs separately counted. Pool call-minute costs as total service cost divided by total actual connected media seconds/60, including caller speech, agent speech, tool waits and silence—not agent speaking time alone. SIMULATOR/JUDGE cost is separately summed and never enters agent service cost. |
| Trigger / dial event | `event_id`, form/import type, original submission timestamp, pre-outcome `eligible_queue`, `eligible_immediate_call`, blocked/deferred reasons, linked task creation timestamp and ID, provider-accepted dial/start ID and timestamp or explicitly observed non-start, observation deadline and clock validity. Deduplicate input events by ID; do not create recall opportunities from duplicate deliveries. For the immediate-call population, the ≤60-second target means every fully observed eligible event starts by its 60-second deadline; report deadline misses and fraction met, not just a favorable mean. |

A third party can recompute numeric rates from these reviewed labels and raw references; the arithmetic cannot itself certify whether a semantic label is true. Current `results.json` supplies CRM/tool/transcript data; Step 6 retrieval artifacts supply draft ranked IDs; the canonical ledger and request journals supply existing text usage. Claims/authorization review, trigger/dial receipts, audio/reference data and real timing must be added before those metrics can be finite. Until then emit explicit null with the missing artifact/review reason. This is a frozen measurement contract, not a claim that the missing instrumentation exists.

# Step 8 technical review and corrections

AI technical review is not human semantic approval, independent holdout review, judge calibration or execution permission. No provider/network requests, new heldout cases or audio runs were involved.

## Initial review

Reviewer `92b1b44f-7c99-40c` compared the full M1 §5 objectives and confirmed all original numerical targets were retained. It reported three important issues:

1. **Insufficient matrix validation.** The initial checker verified shape/hash/runtime but could accept changed scenario/model/count or nested authorization values before sealing. Corrected: compare the complete settings against the registered plan using sorted JSON serialization, after membership/hash/runtime gates. This also preserves JSON type distinctions. Totals are derived from checked cells. Regression tests change model, scenario, temperature, targeted count and nested voice/heldout authorization, plus repetition slots, hash/membership/runtime and top-level authorization.
2. **Final state is not a complete write audit.** A bad write can be reversed. Corrected: retain all-task and write-task exact-state accuracy, but separately require complete reviewed action scope and no spurious committed writes for original M1 O2 accuracy. Undoing a bad write does not erase it. Unknown audit means unknown original O2, even if exact state is known.
3. **Escalation unit mismatch.** Counting suggestions over cases could exceed 100%. Corrected: one binary prediction per attempt, explicit TP/FP/FN/TN, repeated suggestions count once; suggestions remain separate from persisted handoffs.

The reviewer initially ran 13 focused offline tests, passing. Its follow-up verified the three corrections and ran 14 focused tests, passing. These are arithmetic/integrity tests, not measured model outcomes.

## Follow-up terminology finding

The reviewer found inconsistent cost wording after the estimate basis was clarified. The parent replaced “observed actual subtotal” and the remaining cost-row wording with **observed usage-priced subtotal / application estimate**, keeping reservations separate and invoice reconciliation distinct. This final wording correction was parent-checked; no further independent approval is claimed.

Other parent clarifications retained before sealing: preserve Unicode combining marks in WER; exact critical-field canonical rules; explicit queue/immediate-call eligibility and 60-second deadline; literal M1 already-contacted calls versus sandbox 24-hour retries; one primary architecture pair for the two-endpoint Holm family; actual audible speech rather than model or transport timestamps; source/caller/action claim scopes; draft annotation and telemetry gaps.

## Attempts retained

The first targeted measurement-test invocation failed at import because the new test lacked this repository's `src` path setup. Receipt: `measurement-tests-first.json`. Fixed using the existing test pattern, not a runtime/package change. The first full suite passed 113 tests; its receipt and tested hashes are preserved separately from final post-freeze checks. Freeze creation/check and overwrite-refusal commands also have separate logs and exit receipts.

No historical scores, policy/data inputs, pending adjudications, canonical ledger or user README/prompts were changed. The existing progress and experiment-log files receive explicit Step 8 append-only entries. Any future runtime implementation, annotation approval or model change needs a prospective amendment before new comparison observations; never silently rewrite this seal.

**Measurement definitions and prospective development settings frozen; execution blocked.** Read the full M1 §5 O1–O11 definitions and retain all original targets, including duplicate-lead ≤2%, unsupported claims ≤3%, handoff completeness ≥90% and every O11 significance/overhead condition. `measurement_protocol.md` defines numerators, denominators, exclusions, nulls, per-metric evidence/annotation contracts and known artifact gaps.

- Strict completion = exact CRM + all required information + safety, with invalid components propagating null. Original two-factor M1 O1 remains separately reported. Preserve independently scorable CRM evidence and all-attempt coverage/bounds; never label invalid judging an agent failure.
- Separate final-state exactness (all tasks/write subset) from original O2 action-audited correctness. Wrong-record, duplicate, prohibited events, unconfirmed committed actions, false-success claims and blocked unsafe attempts have separate denominators/counts. A reversed bad write is not erased.
- Define claim truth/corpus support/context faithfulness, per-attempt escalation precision/recall, persisted handoff/field completeness, reviewed retrieval Recall@k/canonical coverage/abstention, gate decisions versus actual dialing, and queue recall versus actual call-start deadlines. Current draft labels and missing instrumentation cannot certify these measurements.
- Fix WER normalization (NFKC/casefold, preserve Unicode combining marks, punctuation boundaries, no filler/number expansion), Levenshtein tie rule, critical-field canonicals and empty-reference behavior. Voice latency is actual caller speech end to first audible agent speech, with separate components and no text-latency proxy. Audio remains absent.
- Cost per conversation/minute is a labelled usage-priced application estimate, with all specialist service cost separated from simulator/judge overhead, reservations and optional invoice reconciliation. Text wall time is not a call minute. No balance or billing guarantee is claimed.
- Freeze `m4-comparison-v1`: 2 agent model snapshots × B0/M1 × short/large × ten core cases × 3 repetitions = **240 planned slots**; six assigned-pack targeted regressions × 2 models × 2 architectures × 1 = **24 separate slots**. Ten repeated scenarios are not 240 independent scenarios. All cells have execution disabled and no approved batch.
- Report all-three consistency (pass^3) separately from any-success pass@3 on complete triplets, with incomplete-triplet coverage/bounds. Future O11 has one fixed primary architecture pair, exact paired McNemar on repetition 1, Holm correction across O1/O3, and 10,000 scenario-cluster bootstrap resamples, fixed seed 20261119. Development does not support adoption; missing voice/cost evidence never passes a gate.
- Hash-seal settings, exact current Python/runtime identity, code, named development inputs, scorer/metric contract and review annotations. Offline checker rejects source/runtime/matrix/nested-flag drift and refuses overwrites. It does not dispatch experiments or authorize existing CLIs. Unimplemented M1/runner/exporter and future audio/protected inputs need prospective versioned amendments before execution.
- Offline suite: **113 tests passed, zero skipped**; integrity check passed; repeated freeze creation refused with expected exit 1. AI review identified three issues (matrix validation, O2 undo semantics, O6 units), corrected and regression-tested; follow-up terminology correction retained. Initial import-error/full-suite attempts remain in `evidence/step8/`.

No paid requests, audio sessions, heldout authoring/inspection, provider changes or next-milestone runs.
